ITEM 1 | Broccoli florets, bright green with darker green tips, fairly firm, clustered in the upper-left of the plate with a few small stems; footprint roughly 1/5 of the plate, about 3 cm tall piled | 90
ITEM 2 | Cherry tomatoes, glossy red-orange whole halves and whole small fruits, smooth skin, firm and intact, scattered in a loose line across the center-left of the plate; about 6 pieces, each about 2 cm across | 60
ITEM 3 | Red onion rings, purplish-white translucent slices, slightly curled, soft and moist, lying under the fish near the top-right edge; footprint about 5 x 4 cm, under 1 cm thick | 15
ITEM 4 | Fish fillet piece with dark charred-looking skin on top and pinkish-orange flesh beneath, slightly glossy, flakes at the edges, sits upper-right; about 7 x 4 cm, roughly 2 cm thick | 90
ITEM 5 | Fish fillet piece, pale orange-pink flesh with golden-brown seared surface and flecks of herb and small pale particles, slightly moist, holds shape; about 8 x 4 cm, roughly 1.5 cm thick, lower-right of the plate | 85
ITEM 6 | Small golden-brown crouton-like crumb piece, dry and crisp, lying at the far left near the broccoli; about 3 x 2 cm, under 0.5 cm thick | 4
ITEM 7 | Small scattered crumbs and bits of pale golden material near the tomatoes and fish, dry and crumbly; total footprint under 2 x 2 cm | 2
ITEM 8 | Small red pepper fragment, bright red, glossy, a few mm to 1 cm long, next to the tomatoes | 2
